arte.universo: Brno (Moravia, Austrian Empire) between 1843 and 1884: an old stone Augustinian abbey with arched corridors and a quiet walled garden full of climbing pea plants on wooden sticks, a long greenhouse with wooden frames, a simple room with a wooden table covered in bowls of dried yellow and green peas, an empty 19th-century university corridor with heavy wooden doors, and a small 19th-century meeting hall with wooden chairs and oil lamps; and a modern Mexican home today. No portraits and no recognizable real people: the monk-scientist is never shown, only his objects and places. Anonymous people only from behind or far away. No readable writing, letters or digits anywhere.

escena.accion: At dusk in a quiet walled garden of an old stone abbey, the Pasita walks between long rows of tall climbing pea plants tied to wooden sticks, some pods open showing round yellow and green peas; a soft lime-green glow lights the pods
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, seen from behind, small school backpack, looking up at the tall pea plants
escena.objeto: Rows of climbing pea plants with white flowers and open pods of yellow and green peas, softly glowing lime green
escena.foreground: Pea leaves and a wooden watering can, slightly blurred
escena.background: Old stone abbey walls with arched windows and a small bell tower in the haze
escena.iluminacion: Warm last sunlight on the stone, cool blue shadows, soft lime glow on the pods
escena.composicion: Medium-wide shot from behind; the upper 42% is the calm dark evening sky above the abbey wall for the title

cuerpo: Para seguir estudiando, **entró a un monasterio**.

escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-left, seen from behind, small backpack, holding a few old books
escena.objeto: A few old leather-bound books tied with string
escena.foreground: A stone column and the edge of a wooden bench, slightly blurred
escena.background: The arched corridor fading into shadow, the tiny distant robed figure from behind, light from a courtyard
escena.iluminacion: Pale daylight through the arches, deep shadows on the vaulted ceiling
escena.emocion: A new beginning, humble and hopeful
escena.composicion: Wide shot with vanishing point; the upper 42% dark vaulted stone ceiling

escena.accion: In an empty 19th-century university corridor, the Pasita sits alone on a wooden bench beside a closed heavy wooden door, holding a closed notebook on her lap, a little sad but calm
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-right, three-quarter view from behind, backpack beside her on the bench

escena.accion: In a simple abbey room at night, the Pasita sits at a wooden table sorting dried peas into small bowls: many round yellow peas in some bowls and fewer green peas in others, with empty pea pods scattered around
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, three-quarter view from behind, backpack on the chair, carefully picking up a single green pea
escena.objeto: Small clay bowls filled with yellow peas and with green peas, a pile of empty pods, a quill and a notebook with only tiny tally marks (no letters, no digits)
escena.foreground: Scattered peas and pods on the table edge, slightly blurred
escena.background: Stone wall, a small arched window with night sky, shelves with jars of seeds

escena.accion: In a small 19th-century meeting hall lit by oil lamps, the Pasita stands at the back watching rows of mostly empty wooden chairs, with only a few anonymous listeners seen from behind, some looking away; a distant small lectern stands with nobody at it
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-left, seen from behind, backpack on, holding a thin plain booklet against her chest
escena.objeto: A thin plain booklet with no writing
escena.foreground: The back of an empty wooden chair, slightly blurred
escena.background: Half-empty rows of chairs, a few anonymous listeners from behind, an empty lectern under a lamp

escena.composicion: Wide shot; the upper 42% dark wooden ceiling

cuerpo: Hoy explica por qué **te pareces a tu familia**.

escena.accion: In a modern Mexican living room in the evening, the Pasita looks at a wall full of framed family photos showing only small blurry silhouettes of anonymous people; on a shelf below, a small clay bowl of green and yellow peas glows softly lime green
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, seen from behind, backpack on, looking up at the photo wall
escena.objeto: Framed photos with blurry anonymous silhouettes (no faces, no text) and a small bowl of yellow and green peas with a soft lime glow
escena.foreground: The arm of a sofa with a folded blanket, slightly blurred
escena.background: The photo wall, a window with a warm city evening
escena.iluminacion: Warm lamp light, cool evening from the window, lime glow from the peas
escena.emocion: Recognition: an old idea in everyday life
escena.composicion: Medium-wide shot; the upper 42% dark calm wall above the photos

post:
Gregor Mendel era hijo de campesinos. Para poder seguir estudiando, en 1843 entró a un monasterio en Brno (hoy República Checa). 🌱

Quiso ser maestro de ciencias y reprobó el examen dos veces, así que siguió dando clases como suplente. Mientras, en la huerta del monasterio, entre 1856 y 1863 cruzó casi 30 mil plantas de chícharo y contó con paciencia cuántos salían amarillos y cuántos verdes. Así descubrió que la herencia sigue reglas.

Lo explicó en 1865 y casi nadie le hizo caso. Murió en 1884 sin reconocimiento. En 1900, tres científicos llegaron por su cuenta a lo mismo y le dieron la razón. Hoy sus ideas se estudian como las leyes de Mendel y explican por qué te pareces a tu familia.

¿A quién de tu familia te pareces tú? 👇
